setup_logging_hermes_home: setup the hermes logging subsystem with a custom hermes home directory path
setup_logging_gateway_mode: setup hermes logging in gateway mode to create a separate gateway.log file for gateway component records
setup_logging_custom_level: setup hermes logging with a custom log level and max size from config.yaml
set_session_context: set the session context for the current thread so all log lines include the session tag
clear_session_context: clear the session context for the current thread so session tags stop appearing in log output
setup_verbose_logging: enable DEBUG-level console logging for verbose mode with a RedactingFormatter stream handler
add_rotating_handler: add an idempotent rotating file handler to a logger with optional component filter and managed file permissions
read_logging_config: read the logging configuration section from config.yaml returning level max size and backup count
component_filter_prefixes: filter log records by logger name prefix to route gateway or agent component logs to separate files
